title: Record the rank-7 frame lines
body:
## Summary
- The four named frames each span 128 vectors. Their annihilators are the lines `30 xor 42 = 52`, `25 xor 42 = 51`, `7 xor 25 = 30` and `7 xor 52 = 51`.
- With the V45 line `7 xor 42 = 45`, these are five of the seven lines in the 8-point space `{0, 7, 25, 30, 42, 45, 51, 52}`. Any two of the five frames meet in 64 vectors.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
